record.question:
Which of the following fees/income can be retained by a Government servant in full without special permission and without crediting one-third of the amount?
I. Income received by a Government servant from regular remunerative occupation in the nature of part time employment.
II. Where he receives royalties on a book which is a mere compilation of Government Rules, regulations and procedures.
III. Income from property
IV. Income from occasional participation in sports as Umpires
record.explanation: Income from property and occasional sports umpiring can be retained in full.
